## [13.0.0](https://github.com/cdktn-io/cdktn-provider-dns/compare/v12.1.1...v13.0.0) (2026-08-07)


### ⚠ BREAKING CHANGES

* update  CDKTN version to `0.24.0` (#49)

* update  CDKTN version to `0.24.0` (#45)
* **deps:** update  minimum Node version to `24.11.0` (#38)

* update  CDKTN version to `0.24.0` ([#45](https://github.com/cdktn-io/cdktn-provider-postgresql/issues/45)) ([2a6604c](https://github.com/cdktn-io/cdktn-provider-postgresql/commit/2a6604cc3a7175126752750432127837a8eee7b6))
